description: uiIntent v3 — Semantic UI intent schema for CarrotFin Detail Planner. Replaces uiDirective. LLM emits field references + contextual content + display intents. Backend projects onto palette components.

message.description: Conversational text to the user. Always required.

collect.description: Populate when this turn needs user input. List the fields to collect.

formTitle.description: Title for the input group when collecting multiple fields, e.g., 'Monthly Expenses', 'Income Details'. Populate when emitting 2+ fields.

fields.description: Ordered list of fields to collect this turn. One field = standalone input. Multiple fields = grouped form.

fieldRef.description: fieldId from coreFieldSchema, e.g., 'monthlyNetIncome', 'employmentType'. Use for all known profile fields.

jitField.description: Inline field definition. Use ONLY when coreFieldSchema lacks the needed field.

entityGroupId.description: Entity group this field collects for: 'person_1', 'person_2', 'household_1'.

title.description: Contextual label. Omit to use the default label from coreFieldSchema.

description.description: Context explaining why this is being asked or what to include.

exclusions.description: What NOT to include, referencing other fields.

optionDescriptions.description: Per-option descriptions for choice fields needing explanatory context. Array order matches enumValues in coreFieldSchema.

present.description: Display intents. Each entry becomes one display component.

resultKind.description: What this display block represents. KPI = computed target/score. PHASE_GATE = review collected data. STATUS = goal/plan state. CONFIRMATION = post-action receipt. ALLOCATION = proportional split. PLAN = savings timeline.

headline.description: Hero value display. Required for KPI, STATUS, CONFIRMATION. Optional for PHASE_GATE.

subtitle.description: Contextual qualifier, e.g., '~6 months of essential expenses'.

itemsHeader.description: Section header above items, e.g., 'How we got here', 'Your milestones'.

items.description: Data rows. Interpretation depends on resultKind. PHASE_GATE: field-value pairs. KPI: attribution factors. ALLOCATION: proportional segments. PLAN: timeline milestones. STATUS/CONFIRMATION: state rows.

label.description: Row name: field label, factor name, segment name, or milestone name.

value.description: Primary content: formatted amount, date, impact, or display value.

key.description: Field identifier for edit routing. Populate for PHASE_GATE items.

detail.description: Secondary text: explanation, vehicle/instrument, or milestone amount.

indicator.description: Directional or status signal: UP, DOWN, NEUTRAL, UPCOMING, REACHED.

icon.description: Emoji for this item. Populate for ALLOCATION segments.

shortLabel.description: Abbreviated label for constrained surfaces. Populate for ALLOCATION bar segments.

intent.description: CONFIRM = affirm reviewed data. ACKNOWLEDGE = absorbed information. EDIT = revise inputs. EXPLORE = explore scenario.
